jobs.title: Videographer and Photographer Internship at Leonards Lens
jobs.description: Employer: Leonards Lens Expires: 11/12/2026 Videographer and Photographer InternshipLeonard's LensAbout Leonard's LensLeonard's Lens is a Tampa-based marketing and operations consultancy working with small businesses, nonprofits, independent artists, and community organizations. Our work spans brand strategy, digital advertising, campaign execution, and community impact. We move fast, we care about quality, and we believe great content tells a story worth paying attention to.The RoleWe are looking for a creative, dependable Videographer and Photographer Intern to join our team in Tampa. This is a hands-on, on-the-ground role. You will be the person who is there when things happen: events, community projects, artist shows, client activations, and the everyday moments behind the work. You will work directly with our founder and capture the photos and video that our social media and brand teams turn into finished content.This is an in-person internship based in the Tampa Bay area, open on a rolling basis to students in film, media, communications, photography, marketing, and related programs.What You Will DoFollow our founder, Leo Mathews, to events, meetings, community projects, and everyday work moments, capturing photo and video as they happen.Shoot photo and video at Leonard's Lens events, client events, and community activations, including live music, festivals, and neighborhood projects.Capture on-the-spot interviews, audience reactions, and short story-driven clips.Anticipate which shots will tell a complete story before, during, and after an event.Do quick edits and turn around same-day or next-day clips for Stories and Reels.Organize and label raw footage and photos in shared folders so the content team can find and use them fast.Coordinate shot lists and ideas with our social media and brand design team members.Use good judgment and discretion when capturing personal and behind the scenes moments.Expect a few shoots per week, with some evenings and weekends depending on the event calendar. Quality over quantity is the standard.What We Are Looking ForA good eye for framing, light, and storytelling. Comfort shooting with a phone or your own camera. Basic editing skills in CapCut, iMovie, Lightroom, or similar tools. Someone who stays calm in fast moving, crowded, unpredictable environments and is comfortable approaching strangers for a quick interview. Reliable transportation and flexible availability for evenings and weekends. Someone who takes creative direction well and knows how to push back respectfully when they have a better idea. Experience is less important than curiosity, work ethic, and genuine interest in community and culture.A phone camera is fine to start. If you have a camera, stabilizer, or microphone, bring it.AI tools are welcome for editing and workflow efficiency. Content that looks AI generated or feels generic is not the standard we hold ourselves to.All photos and video created for Leonard's Lens belong to Leonard's Lens. With permission, you can use approved pieces in your portfolio.Location & CompensationIn person in the Tampa Bay area, with travel to events and partner sites as needed$200/month stipend for gas and free entry and meals to events. What You Will Walk Away WithA portfolio of real photo and video work from live events, community projects, and brand campaigns. Hands-on experience in event coverage, documentary style storytelling, and fast turnaround content. An understanding of how photo and video fit into a broader marketing strategy. Direct mentorship from a working marketing professional with over a decade of industry experience.To ApplySend a short note about yourself, why this role interests you, and two or three examples of photo or video you have created. They do not need to be professional. They need to be authentic.Contact: Leo Mathews | Grow@leonardslens.com | 219.201.0312

jobs.description: Employer: Haworth Expires: 11/12/2026 At Haworth, we're not just creating office furniture; we're shaping dynamic workspaces. As a global leader in workspace solutions, we're on a journey to redefine the future of work. Headquartered in Holland, Michigan, Haworth is a family-owned global powerhouse at the forefront of innovation and sustainable design in the workspace interiors industry. Here, you'll get hands-on with state-of-the-art resources, interact with cross-functional teams of passionate innovators, and experience a blend of global reach and family-owned feel. Whether you're developing new manufacturing processes, implementing smart factory solutions, or designing tomorrow's workspace solutions, you'll be empowered to make a lasting impact.We are currently looking for a paid Marketing Graphics & Content Intern to join our Architectural Solutions team in Holland, MI. This position will be working onsite at the Haworth Corporate Headquarters.Job OverviewAs a Graphic Designer Intern on the Architectural Solutions team, you'll combine design, animation, and visual storytelling to bring our products to life. You will create 3D animations, exploded views, and training resources that help dealers and installers understand our architectural wall systems, freestanding solutions, and Hush Office pods. Working closely with product experts, you'll transform technical information into engaging digital content that supports training, improves user understanding, and contributes to customer-facing web tools. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend creativity with technical design while developing materials that have a direct impact on how our solutions are experienced in the field.Get ready for an adventurous summer as a Haworth intern! You'll join a cohort of around 50 other dynamic interns for a 12-week program packed with meaningful projects and weekly learning opportunities. You'll attend NeoCon, the largest commercial design event in the world, where you will get an insider's look at all the latest industry trends and innovations. Sharpen your skills with interactive workshops on networking, public speaking, and using AI tools in a business environment. Connect with mentors and see all areas of the office and manufacturing processes. Then unwind at intern-only social events where you can meet people from all corners of the business. By the end of the summer, you'll leave with real skills, an expanded professional network, and memories to last a lifetime. This is your chance to take your career to new heights!Required QualificationsFull-time college enrollment, working towards a Bachelor's Degree in Graphic Design, Interior Design, Architecture, Industrial Design, or related field with at least a junior level status by Fall of 2027.Ability to work onsite in Holland, MI from May 2027 to August 2027.Applicants must possess an unrestricted right to work in the US to be eligible for the position.Preferred QualificationsA portfolio demonstrating coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional work related to interior design, architecture, product design, visualization, or digital content creation is preferred.Overall GPA of 2.95 or higherPrior Haworth experienceExperience with CAD and 3D design software such as Autodesk Inventor, Creo, and AutoCADExperience with visualization and animation tools such as SolidWorks Composer, Blender, and 3ds MaxFamiliarity with Adobe Creative SuitePrevious Employment experienceExtra-curricular activity experience such as athletics, clubs, volunteer work, etc.Ideally, you have also demonstrated the following:Ability to manage assigned projects to completion.Working knowledge of business software applications, including Microsoft Excel.Desire to learn, question, and research solutions to problems.Organized with the ability to manage deadlines.Effective verbal and written communication skills.
